text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What a racket.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Did you guys really enjoy the race that
much?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Are they responding to me? Or
are they
just carried away by their own
excitement?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Damn! Did I really just lose?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Amazon.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Ugh!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: It was a g—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Shut it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Don't go saying what a good match it
was or
anything like that. And don't
think this is it for
me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get stronger. Much stronger!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I don't care how many times I have to
challenge
you—I'll never give up!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I believe you'll always keep
getting
stronger and you'll always come
back for another
fight.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Tch.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Thanks.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It's been quite the year. Challenging the
Classic
Triple Crown, learning everyone's
strengths, and
forging my own...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I wonder if next year will be like this too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I wouldn't mind that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I can't turn back now that I know how
interesting
this can get. I want more.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What kind of race should I run next
year?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It'll be her senior year. I'd like to see
how the
Hanshin Daishoten goes first,
then decide
whether to shoot for the
prestigious spring Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I was thinking the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.text: Got it. I'll leave the rest to you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Just let me run more and more.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
